# Discrepancy Resolution Contract

Status: active
Owner: orchestrator governance
Version: 1.0.0

## One-round protocol
1. Start discrepancy round.
2. Share only conflicting portions.
3. Request position: maintain | revise | scope.
4. Compare arguments and evidence quality.
5. Produce at least one reconciled option or escalate to user.

## Parallel continuation
- Continue non-conflicting tracks while discrepancy round is active.
- Block only decision paths directly impacted by unresolved conflict.
- Mark partial synthesis as provisional.

## Escalation threshold
- If unresolved after one round, escalate with structured options and trade-offs.
